data_fields.name: search_radius_tiles
data_fields.donor_constant: 70 blocks divided by TILE_SIZE 6 (integer) = 11 tiles, spiral of 23x23 cells

data_fields.name: lot_area_range
data_fields.donor_constant: per call site: 9..(size+1)^2 (myrmidon house), 4..4 (guard tower), 81..82 (airship dock), 6..(size+1)^2 (farm field)

best_idea: Place a lot by growing a rectangle from a seed tile into empty space, with the door on the road, and reject it with a reason when it misses the area or side minimums.
decision_why: The grow-from-seed rule and area and side minimums transfer, with defects 1 and 2 fixed and the seed chosen by the player; the donor has no player housing, so owner and upkeep rules come from elsewhere.
acceptance: The server places a 9x9 lot next to a road with its door on the road; a 5x3 lot at a seed with odd |x+y| never exceeds the area cap; a seed that cannot reach the minimum side is refused with a reason the phone shows.
